# Matt Pocock Agent Skills

These skills are vendored from [mattpocock/skills](https://github.com/mattpocock/skills) at commit `49dd158d1076134a641b33efb035946536778336` (version 1.3.1) in GitHub Copilot's `.github/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` layout.

Each skill includes its `SKILL.md` and any supporting files it references. Provider-specific `agents/openai.yaml` metadata is omitted. The skills are licensed under MIT; see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

To update them, copy the published skills from the upstream repository's `skills/` directories, preserving each skill's supporting files, frontmatter, and license attribution.
